REGLES.R1: All shooters start on the large gong (1 point).
REGLES.R2: If the target is hit, the shooter may continue on the same gong to accumulate points or move to the medium gong (2 points).
REGLES.R3: After hitting the medium gong, the shooter may attempt the small gong (3 points).
REGLES.R4: If a shot is missed, the shooter goes back down one level (e.g., from small to medium).
REGLES.R5: If the wrong gong is targeted, the shot scores 0 and the shooter must return to the last validated gong.

EXEMPLE.R1: Julie hits the large gong (+1), moves to the medium (+2), succeeds, then attempts the small (+3) → provisional score: 6 points.
EXEMPLE.R2: She misses the small gong and must return to the medium.
EXEMPLE.R3: She then misses the medium and drops back to the large gong.

EXCEPTIONS.R1: In case of a technical issue with the firearm (jam, faulty ammunition), the referee may grant extra time.
EXCEPTIONS.R2: If a paper target is damaged or unreadable, the referee may order its replacement and replay the shot.
EXCEPTIONS.R3: In case of an obvious refereeing error or dispute, a shot may be reviewed or replayed.
EXCEPTIONS.R4: If an exceptional safety condition arises, the round is immediately interrupted.
EXCEPTIONS.R5: During a tie-break, a special rule may apply, such as shooting only at the small gong.
